selection_rationale: reuse-first: the accepted retrieval/counter-authority protocol tests, the retrieval gate, the retrieval-instrument falsification legs, the multilingual and cross-lingual robustness tests, the disclosure/provenance crosscheck, the mount-provenance gate, the nested evidence_refs guard, and the new FAST-MVP recall@K instrument contract test. No universal-174k geometry benchmark is run.

pre_existing_failures_not_repaired_with_.why_not_repaired: re-measuring a different claim-bearing record under a new product head is a new measurement with its own run id, not an operational-resume repair
